snippet.title: No Such Place: Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the new release date trailer for No Such Place, the upcoming top-down, pixel-art, retro-styled extraction shooter for 1-4 players in which you and your friends must explore and ultimately escape the Unknown Research Consortium. It will launch into Steam Early Access on October 14. Wishlist it and/or play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299050/No_Such_Place/

#ign #gaming
